rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single static image, but it overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from this somewhat blurry image and does not note the image looks less clearly pristine than a textbook 3AA.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, partner age, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with appropriate caveats about morphology versus ploidy; only minor issue is slightly optimistic framing despite image uncertainty.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including caution about morphology limits and selective PGT-A use; minor speculative emphasis on paternal DNA damage is not central guideline content.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer management, post-transfer care, and contingency planning after failure, with appropriate nuance for future evaluation.
